name: german_article
description: Supply the nominative definite article of a German noun (der/die/das); control repeats the same noun.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
groups={'der':'Mann Hund Tisch Stuhl Baum Apfel Lehrer Vater Bruder Zug Garten Vogel Fisch Schuh Monat','die':'Frau Katze Blume Schule Mutter Schwester Zeitung Stadt Tasche Uhr Lampe Sprache Sonne Milch Hand','das':'Kind Haus Buch Auto Fenster Wasser Brot Mädchen Zimmer Bett Pferd Licht Ei Wort Bild'}
pairs=[(n,a) for a,ns in groups.items() for n in ns.split()]
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(2):
 for n,a in pairs:
  prompt=f'German noun: {n}\n'
  items.append({'prompt':prompt+'Give its nominative singular definite article (der, die, or das).\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+a})
  control.append({'prompt':prompt+'Repeat the noun exactly.\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+n})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
